description: J1702C Jio USB Camera J1702C is a versatile, work from anywhere webcam that delivers ultrawide HD Video along with long range audio for that perfect meeting experience The 120 degree field of view gives wide view of the scene making it equally adept at large family calls, group meetings and even individual meetings while build it in microphone arrays can pick up audio clearly from 4 meters away. Build in algorithms ensure clear images even in low illuminance and clear voice for your presentations and meetings J1702C is certified to be used JioTVCalling and JioMeet applications. It is also compatible with other popular applications such as Microsoft Teams, Zoom, etc * This JIO JCM0112 USB Camera image is for illustration purpose only.
